rules_show_welcome_text_on_user_activati.LABEL: show welcome message on user activation

drupal_message.message: Welcome to Rovas, an application of the community economic system NEO, where participants reward work of others with currency Chron, one can earn for time spent on creating own projects. You can earn your first Chrons for the time you spent registering in Rovas, by click the Add Report button below. Learn more about NEO on the rules page.
